title_en: Winter Session 2026: Tuition Payment and Refund Schedule
summary: Students taking 2026 Winter Session (seasonal) courses must pay the session tuition within the payment period, through any bank or by virtual account. The fee amounts, payment period and refund schedule appear only in the attached guides (Korean and English), which were not read. Courses with fewer than 20 paid students will be finally cancelled on Tuesday, 8 December 2026.
applies_to: The notice does not name the students explicitly. It concerns tuition for 2026 Winter Session (seasonal) courses and asks that payment be made within the period, so it applies to students taking those courses.

dates.what: Final cancellation of Winter Session courses with fewer than 20 paid students

conditions: Tuition must be paid within the payment period. The period is given only in the attachments, which were not read.
A course will be finally cancelled on 8 December 2026 if fewer than 20 students have paid for it.
Refund periods and refund amounts are given only in the attachments, which were not read.
steps: Read the attached guide. An English version is provided: "[Eng] Winter 2026 Session Payment & Refunds Information.pdf". It gives the fee amounts, the payment period and the refund schedule.
Pay the Winter Session tuition within the payment period, at any bank or by virtual account.
translation:
2026 Winter Session Tuition Payment and Refund Schedule

We announce the tuition payment and refund schedule for the 2026 Winter Session (seasonal courses). Please pay within the payment period.

1. Tuition and payment period
※ Final course cancellation (fewer than 20 paid students): Tuesday, 8 December 2026 (2026.12.08.(화))
[The tuition amounts and payment period are not given in the notice text. They appear to be in the attachments, which were not read.]

2. Payment method: any bank, or by virtual account

3. Refund period and refund amounts
[The details are not given in the notice text. They appear to be in the attachments, which were not read.]

Attachment: 2026 Winter Session Tuition Payment Guide (Korean/English)
